usage.isotipo: Use the compact symbol-only isotype in constrained contexts such as login screens, signup screens, mobile headers, collapsed sidebars, and app icons.
usage.logotipo: Use the complete wordmark/logotype in expanded sidebars, full headers, and brand bars. Keep header wordmarks compact by default.
